verses.original: הַחֲמִישִׁ֑י בַּחֹ֖דֶשׁ וַיְהִ֣י׀ הַהִ֗יא בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הָֽרְבִעִ֔ית בִּשְׁנַת בְּרֵאשִׁית֙ מַמְלֶ֙כֶת֙ מֶֽלֶךְ־ צִדְקִיָּ֣ה יְהוּדָ֔ה הַנָּבִ֜יא אֲשֶׁ֤ר חֲנַנְיָה֩ בֶן־ עַזּ֨וּר מִגִּבְעוֹן֙ אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֡י בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֧י הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וְכָל־ הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥă·mî·šî ba·ḥō·ḏeš way·hî ha·hî baš·šā·nāh hā·rə·ḇi·‘îṯ biš·naṯ bə·rê·šîṯ mam·le·ḵeṯ me·leḵ- ṣiḏ·qî·yāh yə·hū·ḏāh han·nā·ḇî ’ă·šer ḥă·nan·yāh ḇen- ‘az·zūr mig·giḇ·‘ō·wn ’ā·mar ’ê·lay bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh lə·‘ê·nê hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām lê·mōr
verses.literal: In the fifth month - of that same year the fourth year near the beginning of the reign of King Zedekiah of Judah the prophet - Hananiah son of Azzur who was from Gibeon said to me in the house of the LORD in the presence of the priests and all the people -

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר אָמַ֞ר שָׁבַ֞רְתִּי אֶת־ עֹ֖ל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr ’ā·mar šā·ḇar·tî ’eṯ- ‘ōl me·leḵ bā·ḇel
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel . . . says I have broken - the yoke of the king of Babylon

verses.original: בְּע֣וֹד׀ שְׁנָתַ֣יִם יָמִ֗ים אֲנִ֤י מֵשִׁיב֙ אֶל־ הַזֶּ֔ה אֶֽת־ הַמָּק֣וֹם כָּל־ כְּלֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נְבוּכַדנֶאצַּ֤ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶל֙ לָקַ֜ח מִן־ הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וַיְבִיאֵ֖ם בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: bə·‘ō·wḏ šə·nā·ṯa·yim yā·mîm ’ă·nî mê·šîḇ ’el- haz·zeh ’eṯ- ham·mā·qō·wm kāl- kə·lê bêṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer nə·ḇū·ḵa·ḏ·nɛṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel lā·qaḥ min- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh way·ḇî·’êm bā·ḇel
verses.literal: - Within two years . . . I will restore to this - place all the articles of the house of the LORD that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon removed from . . . here and carried to Babylon

verses.original: וְאֶת־ אֲנִ֥י מֵשִׁ֛יב אֶל־ הַזֶּ֖ה הַמָּק֥וֹם יְכָנְיָ֣ה בֶן־ יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְ֠הוּדָה וְאֶת־ כָּל־ גָּל֨וּת יְהוּדָ֜ה הַבָּאִ֣ים בָּבֶ֗לָה נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֣י אֶשְׁבֹּ֔ר אֶת־ עֹ֖ל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ’ă·nî mê·šîḇ ’el- haz·zeh ham·mā·qō·wm yə·ḵā·nə·yāh ḇen- yə·hō·w·yā·qîm me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’eṯ- kāl- gā·lūṯ yə·hū·ḏāh hab·bā·’îm bā·ḇe·lāh nə·’um- Yah·weh kî ’eš·bōr ’eṯ- ‘ōl me·leḵ bā·ḇel
verses.literal: And I will restore to this place Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah along with all the exiles from Judah who went to Babylon declares the LORD for I will break - the yoke of the king of Babylon

verses.original: הַנָּבִ֔יא יִרְמְיָ֣ה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ הַנָּבִ֑יא חֲנַנְיָ֖ה לְעֵינֵ֤י הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וּלְעֵינֵ֣י כָל־ הָעָ֔ם הָעֹמְדִ֖ים בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: han·nā·ḇî yir·mə·yāh way·yō·mer ’el- han·nā·ḇî ḥă·nan·yāh lə·‘ê·nê hak·kō·hă·nîm ū·lə·‘ê·nê ḵāl hā·‘ām hā·‘ō·mə·ḏîm bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then the prophet Jeremiah replied to the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests . . . and all the people who were standing in the house of the LORD

verses.original: אָמֵ֕ן הַנָּבִ֔יא יִרְמְיָ֣ה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יְהוָ֑ה יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה כֵּ֖ן יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ יָקֵ֤ם דְּבָרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִבֵּ֗אתָ לְהָשִׁ֞יב כְּלֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ בֵית־ וְכָל־ הַגּוֹלָ֔ה אֶל־ הַזֶּֽה׃ הַמָּק֥וֹם מִבָּבֶ֖ל
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mên han·nā·ḇî yir·mə·yāh way·yō·mer Yah·weh ya·‘ă·śeh kên Yah·weh ’eṯ- yā·qêm də·ḇā·re·ḵā ’ă·šer nib·bê·ṯā lə·hā·šîḇ kə·lê Yah·weh ḇêṯ- wə·ḵāl hag·gō·w·lāh ’el- haz·zeh ham·mā·qō·wm mib·bā·ḇel
verses.literal: Amen - Jeremiah said May the LORD do so May the LORD - fulfill the words - you have prophesied and may He restore the articles of [His] house and all the exiles back to this place from Babylon

verses.original: אַךְ־ שְׁמַֽע־ נָא֙ הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הַדָּבָ֣ר אָנֹכִ֖י דֹּבֵ֣ר בְּאָזְנֶ֑יךָ וּבְאָזְנֵ֖י כָּל־ הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ- šə·ma‘- nā haz·zeh ’ă·šer had·dā·ḇār ’ā·nō·ḵî dō·ḇêr bə·’ā·zə·ne·ḵā ū·ḇə·’ā·zə·nê kāl- hā·‘ām
verses.literal: Nevertheless listen now to this - message I am speaking in your hearing and in the hearing of all the people

verses.original: הַנְּבִיאִ֗ים הָֽעוֹלָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָי֧וּ לְפָנַ֛י מִן־ וּלְפָנֶ֖יךָ וַיִּנָּ֨בְא֜וּ לְמִלְחָמָ֖ה וּלְרָעָ֥ה וּלְדָֽבֶר׃ אֶל־ רַבּוֹת֙ וְעַל־ אֲרָצ֤וֹת גְּדֹל֔וֹת מַמְלָכ֣וֹת
verses.transliteration: han·nə·ḇî·’îm hā·‘ō·w·lām ’ă·šer hā·yū lə·p̄ā·nay min- ū·lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā way·yin·nā·ḇə·’ū lə·mil·ḥā·māh ū·lə·rā·‘āh ū·lə·ḏā·ḇer ’el- rab·bō·wṯ wə·‘al- ’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ
verses.literal: The prophets of old who preceded . . . you and me prophesied war disaster and plague against many . . . lands and great kingdoms

verses.original: הַנָּבִ֕יא אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִנָּבֵ֖א לְשָׁל֑וֹם דְּבַ֣ר הַנָּבִ֗יא בְּבֹא֙ הַנָּבִ֔יא אֲשֶׁר־ יִוָּדַע֙ יְהוָ֖ה בֶּאֱמֶֽת׃ שְׁלָח֥וֹ
verses.transliteration: han·nā·ḇî ’ă·šer yin·nā·ḇê lə·šā·lō·wm də·ḇar han·nā·ḇî bə·ḇō han·nā·ḇî ’ă·šer- yiw·wā·ḏa‘ Yah·weh be·’ĕ·meṯ šə·lā·ḥōw
verses.literal: As for the prophet who prophesies peace only if the word of the prophet comes true will the prophet - be recognized as one the LORD has truly sent

verses.original: הַנָּבִיא֙ אֶת־ חֲנַנְיָ֤ה וַיִּקַּ֞ח הַמּוֹטָ֔ה מֵעַ֕ל צַוַּ֖אר יִרְמְיָ֣ה הַנָּבִ֑יא וַֽיִּשְׁבְּרֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: han·nā·ḇî ’eṯ- ḥă·nan·yāh way·yiq·qaḥ ham·mō·w·ṭāh mê·‘al ṣaw·war yir·mə·yāh han·nā·ḇî way·yiš·bə·rê·hū
verses.literal: Then the prophet - Hananiah took the yoke off the neck of Jeremiah the prophet and broke it

verses.original: לְעֵינֵ֨י כָל־ הָעָ֜ם חֲנַנְיָה֩ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר כֹּה֮ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֒ לֵאמֹ֗ר כָּ֣כָה שְׁנָתַ֣יִם יָמִ֔ים אֶשְׁבֹּ֞ר אֶת־ עֹ֣ל׀ נְבֻֽכַדְנֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֗ל בְּעוֹד֙ מֵעַ֕ל צַוַּ֖אר כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם יִרְמְיָ֥ה הַנָּבִ֖יא וַיֵּ֛לֶךְ לְדַרְכּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: lə·‘ê·nê ḵāl hā·‘ām ḥă·nan·yāh way·yō·mer kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh lê·mōr kā·ḵāh šə·nā·ṯa·yim yā·mîm ’eš·bōr ’eṯ- ‘ōl nə·ḇu·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel bə·‘ō·wḏ mê·‘al- ṣaw·war kāl- hag·gō·w·yim yir·mə·yāh han·nā·ḇî way·yê·leḵ lə·ḏar·kōw
verses.literal: And in the presence of all the people Hananiah proclaimed This is what - the LORD says In this way within two years . . . I will break - the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon - off the neck of all the nations At this, Jeremiah the prophet went on his way

verses.original: אַ֠חֲרֵי חֲנַנְיָ֤ה הַנָּבִיא֙ אֶת־ שְׁב֞וֹר הַמּוֹטָ֔ה מֵעַ֗ל צַוַּ֛אר יִרְמְיָ֥ה הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹֽר׃ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיְהִ֥י אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֑ה
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rê ḥă·nan·yāh han·nā·ḇî ’eṯ- šə·ḇō·wr ham·mō·w·ṭāh mê·‘al ṣaw·war yir·mə·yāh han·nā·ḇî lê·mōr ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh way·hî ’el- yir·mə·yāh
verses.literal: But shortly after Hananiah the prophet - had broken the yoke off [his] neck . . . . . . . . . the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah

verses.original: הָלוֹךְ֩ וְאָמַרְתָּ֨ אֶל־ חֲנַנְיָ֜ה כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה לֵאמֹ֗ר שָׁבָ֑רְתָּ מוֹטֹ֥ת עֵ֖ץ תַחְתֵּיהֶ֖ן וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מֹט֥וֹת בַּרְזֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hā·lō·wḵ wə·’ā·mar·tā ’el- ḥă·nan·yāh kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh lê·mōr šā·ḇā·rə·tā mō·w·ṭōṯ ‘êṣ ṯaḥ·tê·hen wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā mō·ṭō·wṯ bar·zel
verses.literal: Go and tell . . . Hananiah that this is what . . . the LORD says You have broken a yoke of wood but in its place you have fashioned a yoke of iron

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹֽה־ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אָמַר֩ נָתַ֜תִּי עֹ֣ל בַּרְזֶ֡ל עַל־ צַוַּ֣אר׀ כָּל־ הָאֵ֗לֶּה הַגּוֹיִ֣ם לַעֲבֹ֛ד אֶת־ נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל וַעֲבָדֻ֑הוּ וְגַ֛ם אֶת־ נָתַ֥תִּי לֽוֹ׃ חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·mar nā·ṯat·tî ‘ōl bar·zel ‘al- ṣaw·war kāl- hā·’êl·leh hag·gō·w·yim la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- nə·ḇu·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏu·hū wə·ḡam ’eṯ- nā·ṯat·tî lōw ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations to make them serve - Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and they will serve him I have even - given him control of the beasts of the field

verses.original: הַנָּבִ֛יא יִרְמְיָ֧ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ הַנָּבִ֖יא חֲנַנְיָ֥ה שְׁמַֽע־ נָ֣א חֲנַנְיָ֑ה יְהוָ֔ה לֹֽא־ שְׁלָחֲךָ֣ וְאַתָּ֗ה הַזֶּ֖ה הָעָ֥ם הִבְטַ֛חְתָּ אֶת־ עַל־ שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: han·nā·ḇî yir·mə·yāh way·yō·mer ’el- han·nā·ḇî ḥă·nan·yāh šə·ma‘- nā ḥă·nan·yāh Yah·weh lō- šə·lā·ḥă·ḵā wə·’at·tāh haz·zeh hā·‘ām hiḇ·ṭaḥ·tā ’eṯ- ‘al- šā·qer
verses.literal: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah Listen . . . Hananiah The LORD did not send you but you have persuaded this people to trust - in a lie

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה יְהוָ֔ה הִנְנִי֙ אָמַ֣ר מְשַֽׁלֵּֽחֲךָ֔ מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה אַתָּ֣ה מֵ֔ת הַשָּׁנָה֙ כִּֽי־ דִבַּ֖רְתָּ סָרָ֥ה אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh Yah·weh hin·nî ’ā·mar mə·šal·lê·ḥă·ḵā mê·‘al pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’at·tāh mêṯ haš·šā·nāh kî- ḏib·bar·tā sā·rāh ’el- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD . . . says I am about to remove you from the face of the earth You will die this year because you have preached rebellion against the LORD

verses.original: הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃פ בַּחֹ֖דֶשׁ הַהִ֑יא בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַנָּבִ֖יא חֲנַנְיָ֥ה וַיָּ֛מָת
verses.transliteration: haš·šə·ḇî·‘î ba·ḥō·ḏeš ha·hî baš·šā·nāh han·nā·ḇî ḥă·nan·yāh way·yā·māṯ
verses.literal: And in the seventh month of that very year the prophet Hananiah died
